Form 2
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 236
Date 8/4/16
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Central Police Station.
7th April 1916
REPORT ON the Chinese Military situation.
Made by D.S.I.Brewster
FILE
Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector
Sir
The unrest which appears to be spreading throughout the
Chinese Empire appears at last, to be affecting the local Military
situation. It has been a matter of surprise to me that the
troops around Shanghai have kept quiescent for so long as they
have done in view of the many temptations that have been put in
the way of their Commanders by the Rebel Party. Since the New
Year there has been many rumours of intended attacks on the Arsenal
and trouble among the troops and as these rumours did not material-
ize, a feeling of security and confidence in the loyalty of the
troops has formulated in the minds of the Residents of the Settle-
ment. During the last few days however, there has been indication
that a mutiny among the troops is among the possibilities in the
near future. The gravity of the situation which would arise in
the event of a mutiny is obvious and I venture to suggest that
the Settlement Volunteer Authorities be warned in order that they
may be in a position to take immediate steps on short notice.
A meeting mutiny among troops is nearly always more or less impro-
mptu and it is therefor almost impossible to find out beforehand
the time or place contemplated by the ringleaders to commence
operations. In all probability the next trouble at the Arsenal
will start with dramatic suddenness and, if successful, will be
followed up by the occupation by the Rebels of the Arsenal and
neighbouring forts. As the Rebels will in alll probability be
unable to control the troops in the event of a successful rising
the safety of the Settlement will be in danger and I therefor res-
pectfully suggest that the above probabilities be brought to the
notice of the propern authorities
your obedient servant.
DS Brewster D.S.I.

表格 2
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 236 号
日期 1916 年 4 月 8 日
上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央捕房
1916 年 4 月 7 日

关于中国军事局势的报告。
由副巡官布鲁斯特（D.S.I. Brewster）呈报

档案
由首席副巡官转呈

阁下：

似乎正蔓延至整个中华帝国的动荡局势，看来终于影响到了本地的军事状况。令我感到惊讶的是，鉴于反叛党派为驻军指挥官设下的种种诱惑，上海周边的部队竟能如此长久地保持静默。自新年以来，有关意图袭击兵工厂以及部队内部发生骚乱的谣言屡见不鲜，但由于这些谣言并未成为现实，租界居民心中逐渐形成了一种安全感以及对部队忠诚度的信心。然而，在过去几天里，有迹象表明，部队兵变在不久的将来是有可能发生的。一旦发生兵变，其局势之严峻显而易见，因此我冒昧建议，应向租界义勇队当局发出警告，以便他们能够在接到短期通知后立即采取行动。

部队中的集体兵变几乎总是带有几分即兴性质，因此几乎不可能事先查明主谋计划开始行动的时间或地点。极有可能，兵工厂的下一场动乱将以戏剧性的突然方式爆发，并且如果成功，随之而来的将是反叛派占领兵工厂及邻近炮台。由于在起义成功的情况下，反叛派很可能无法控制部队，租界的安全将受到威胁，因此我谨建议将上述可能性提请有关当局注意。

您顺从的仆人。
副巡官 D.S. 布鲁斯特
